Problem.content: Penelitian ini mengevaluasi peluncuran pilot GenAI "no-regret" dalam satu kuartal untuk meningkatkan nilai pada Alpes Bank.
Problem.quote: deliver a “no-regret” GenAI pilot within one quarter

Domain & Data.content: Studi kasus pada Alpes Bank, bank universal Swiss, menggunakan email inquiry sebagai data; bahasa tidak disebut.
Domain & Data.quote: Alpes Bank, a Swiss universal bank whose branch-centric, premium-service model is challenged by generative AI

RAG Method.content: Tim membangun email assistant berbasis retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) bekerja sama dengan AILabs; detail teknis tidak disebut.
RAG Method.quote: builds a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) email assistant with an external partner (i.e., AILabs)

Evaluation & Metrics.content: Evaluasi dilakukan dengan mengukur pengurangan waktu penanganan inquiry rutin, tercatat penurunan 21%.
Evaluation & Metrics.quote: the GenAI email assistant reduces handling time for routine inquiries by 21%

Main Results.content: Email assistant berbasis GenAI mengurangi waktu penanganan inquiry rutin sebesar 21%.
Main Results.quote: the GenAI email assistant reduces handling time for routine inquiries by 21%

Gap.content: Inferensi: Penelitian ini tidak mengevaluasi faithfulness atau abstention pada dokumen produk perbankan berbahasa Indonesia, sehingga tidak menjawab fokus riset yang diusulkan.
Gap.quote: Bank move from a special-project setup to an organizational design and governance process that supports enterprise-wide scaling

Problem.text: This teaching case portrays Alpes Bank, a Swiss universal bank whose branch-centric, premium-service model is challenged by generative AI (GenAI). This teaching case follows Tamara Maurer’s board mandate to deliver a “no-regret” GenAI pilot within one quarter. After evaluating several GenAI use cases, Tamara Maurer’s team builds a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) email assistant with an external partner (i.e., AILabs). The GenAI pilot surfaces several unexpected tensions. Nonetheless, during a limited rollout, the GenAI email assistant reduces handling time for routine inquiries by 21%. Part B focuses on laying the foundation for scaling GenAI use cases. Tamara Maurer must now help Alpes Bank move from a special-project setup to an organizational design and governance process that supp

Bank move from a special-project setup to an organizational design and governance process that supports enterprise-wide scaling. Questions arise about where, in general, AI-related activities should be positioned within Alpes Bank and what new roles are necessary to govern GenAI use cases effectively.

Domain & Data.text: Bank move from a special-project setup to an organizational design and governance process that supports enterprise-wide scaling. Questions arise about where, in general, AI-related activities should be positioned within Alpes Bank and what new roles are necessary to govern GenAI use cases effectively.
